tasks.title: Tailwind CSS 4 업그레이드 및 스타터 정리
tasks.description: Upgrade Tailwind CSS from 3.4.1 to v4, migrate theme tokens to @theme inline, replace tailwindcss-animate with tw-animate-css, and remove starter template components
tasks.details:
1. Install Tailwind CSS v4 dependencies:
   npm install tailwindcss@next @tailwindcss/postcss@next
   npm uninstall autoprefixer tailwindcss-animate
   npm install tw-animate-css

2. Migrate tailwind.config.ts to app/globals.css:
   - Move theme.extend.colors to @theme inline block
   - Move borderRadius tokens to CSS variables
   - Keep darkMode as @custom-variant dark
   - Delete tailwind.config.ts after migration

3. Update postcss.config.mjs:
   module.exports = {
     plugins: {
       '@tailwindcss/postcss': {}
     }
   }

4. Verify components.json has empty tailwind.config value

5. Remove starter components:
   - components/tutorial/** (all files)
   - components/hero.tsx
   - components/deploy-button.tsx
   - components/next-logo.tsx
   - components/supabase-logo.tsx

6. Test: npm run build should succeed with no errors
7. Verify all auth pages (login, sign-up, forgot-password, update-password) render without visual breakage
tasks.testStrategy: Run `npm run build` to ensure build succeeds. Manually test all 4 auth pages (/auth/login, /auth/sign-up, /auth/forgot-password, /auth/update-password) for visual regressions. Verify dark mode toggle works correctly using ThemeSwitcher component.

tasks.title: 핵심 기능 통합 테스트
tasks.description: Perform end-to-end integration testing of entire user journey from signup to search/filter/toggle/delete, verify edge cases, and document any regressions
tasks.details:
This is a comprehensive QA task using Playwright MCP to validate all features work together correctly.

1. Create test scenarios document: tests/e2e-scenarios.md

2. Test full user journey:
   - Start from landing page
   - Sign up new account
   - Login
   - Verify redirect to /links
   - See empty state
   - Save first link with metadata
   - Save second link (metadata fail → manual)
   - Add tags and memo
   - Toggle read/favorite
   - Search and filter
   - Delete link
   - Logout

3. Edge cases:
   - Very long title (300+ chars)
   - Very long URL (1000+ chars)
   - Link with no tags
   - Link with no memo
   - Special characters in search (unicode, emoji)
   - Thumbnail load failure (broken image)
   - Invalid image URL

4. Error scenarios:
   - Network timeout during metadata fetch
   - Server Action failure (simulate DB error)
   - Concurrent updates (2 tabs, toggle same link)
   - Invalid URL formats

5. Security checks:
   - Non-authenticated access to /links → redirect
   - RLS enforcement (cannot access other user's links)
   - XSS attempt in search query
   - SQL injection attempt in search

6. Performance:
   - Page load time for 100+ links
   - Search response time
   - Optimistic update responsiveness

7. Accessibility:
   - Keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Esc)
   - Screen reader labels (aria-label)
   - Focus management in dialogs

Document all failures in respective task files for regression fixes.

tasks.title: Vercel 배포 및 실사용 검증
tasks.description: Deploy to Vercel, configure environment variables, update Supabase auth redirect URLs, run smoke tests in production, and verify OG metadata collection edge cases
tasks.details:
1. Prepare for deployment:
   - Ensure all environment variables are documented
   - Create .env.example:
     NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=
     NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=
     SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=

2. Deploy to Vercel:
   - Connect GitHub repository to Vercel
   - Set environment variables in Vercel dashboard
   - Deploy main branch
   - Note deployment URL (e.g., linklink.vercel.app)

3. Update Supabase Auth configuration:
   - Go to Supabase dashboard → Authentication → URL Configuration
   - Add production URL to redirect URLs:
     - https://linklink.vercel.app/auth/callback
     - https://linklink.vercel.app/auth/confirm
   - Update site URL to production domain

4. Verify production build:
   - Check build logs for errors
   - Verify all pages load without 500 errors
   - Check browser console for client-side errors

5. Run smoke tests in production (Playwright MCP or manual):
   - Sign up new account
   - Save link with OG metadata
   - Search and filter
   - Toggle read/favorite
   - Delete link
   - Logout and login

6. Test OG metadata collection edge cases:
   - Login-required page (e.g., private GitHub repo) → expect manual fallback
   - SNS private post (e.g., Twitter private account) → expect manual fallback
   - Slow-loading site → verify timeout works
   - Site with malformed OG tags → verify graceful failure

7. Document findings:
   - Update PRD section "[확인 필요]" with real-world OG collection results
   - If manual fallback is insufficient, note as future improvement
   - If sufficient, mark as verified

8. Post-deployment checklist:
   - ✅ SSL certificate active (HTTPS)
   - ✅ Environment variables loaded
   - ✅ Database migrations applied
   - ✅ Auth redirects working
   - ✅ All smoke tests passing
   - ✅ No console errors
   - ✅ Mobile responsive
   - ✅ Dark mode working

9. Optional: Custom domain setup (if applicable)
   - Configure DNS
   - Add domain to Vercel
   - Update Supabase redirect URLs

10. Monitor production:
    - Check Vercel analytics for errors
    - Monitor Supabase logs for RLS policy violations
    - Watch for metadata fetch timeouts
